releases.notes:
# ⛏️ Spawner Harvest

Ever wished you could just... take that spawner? Now you can.

- Mine any mob spawner with **Silk Touch** and pocket it – plus a **spawn egg** of its mob
- Rebuild your perfect mob farm wherever you want
- Bonus: every mob you kill has a tiny chance to drop its own spawn egg

Go catch 'em all. 🥚

---
**Requires:** Minecraft 26.2 · Fabric Loader + Fabric API
**Also on:** [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/spawner-harvest)
